intention: Stage 3 of the /chart chain: the SURVEY brick. One narrow question: what already EXISTS that bears on this request? Not what is asked (orient), not what bounds it (constrain), not how to split it (decompose) — the inventory of the territory: HOLDINGS (what exists, each with an address that resolves) and ABSENCES (what was sought and not found, each with the measure that established it), under an explicit SOUGHT list (the coverage record — the sweep that never ran wide is the founding failure). Three strata: FLOOR — template-filled from the berthed constrain packet (the chain deepens: survey -> constrain -> orient), it surfaces each ref'd component's device_census ROW VERBATIM (the orient instrument is the settled measurer; charter/proofs/validations/devices/emit-sites as measured facts) plus existence-measured non-component refs; TREE — the survey brick's own corpus through the generalized verbs; CEILING — assembles sought/holdings/absences/unknowns with per-field provenance. Built UNDER the pre-installed judges (ticket survey-filters): the berth door composes judge_survey by identity; the module cannot shape its own acceptance.
why: The preamble's survey pass is where premature convergence hides most comfortably: a builder who 'knows' the territory skips the sweep and builds what already exists (stone 1's parallel roster, 2026-07-28 — the survey that never ran) or asserts absence from a word-grep ('0 of 13', 2026-07-27). The wide sweep is the work that earns its keep (charter falsifier 7: parsimony must not squeeze it) — and the packet makes the sweep INSPECTABLE: sought says where the light was pointed, holdings say what it found with addresses a gate can re-check at promotion, absences say what it didn't with the measure on record. The floor composes device_census rather than reading charters directly because survey's question is MEASURED state (what is provably there: proofs, validations, devices), not authored intent — constrain already surfaced the charter text; re-surfacing it here would be the parallel-scan drift.
traces_to: Law 1 — the settled territory is walked, not re-derived: survey's floor is the census, and its tree remembers what past sweeps found for this class of request
Law 3 — a holding is a measurement (address resolves), an absence carries its measure; an unmeasured inventory is a hypothesis
Law 4 — the schema gate + composed judges make a skipped or hollow sweep a build error, not a lapse
Law 8 — the brick's first berthed packet passes judges it did not write (survey-filters, the live gate)

falsifier: RED on any of: stage 3 filling from the conversation instead of the berthed stage-2 file; the floor reading charters or scanning in parallel instead of composing device_census; a holding without a resolving address or an absence without its measure passing the door; the door and the promotion gate disagreeing (identity is the claim); the dial unable to read a survey berth (the stage must register its field shape); the deposit-back seeding the tree with a packet whose berth is not on disk.
horizon: re-read when decompose lands (stage 4 template-fills from the survey berth — the chain's next link); when a real sweep needs call_sites or import_map at the floor (the census row is v0's measured fact; more scans compose in against measured need, never speculatively); when /moreabout signals show survey fields recurrently too compressed.
distinctions_recorded: SURVEY MEASURES STATE, CONSTRAIN SURFACES INTENT: both floors read the same refs, but constrain quotes the charter (authored bounds) and survey reads the census (measured facts) — the same address, two different questions, no overlap and no gap between stages 2 and 3.

THE CHAIN NOW HAS DEPTH 3: survey's berth points at constrain's, which points at orient's — and the door re-checks the WHOLE chain (a survey over a constrain berth whose orient berth is gone refuses; a broken link anywhere is a loud refusal, not a silent shallow fill).

THE FLOOR'S FIRST LIVE FIRE CAUGHT ITS OWN FALSE ABSENCE: the first cast's existence check was narrower than the gate's ref_exists (no commons fallback), so two FILED tickets reported as missing — a false absence, the exact failure class this brick polices, caught by the brick's own first real run (the stone-1 pattern again: the instrument's first act is to catch its builder). Cured by composing the ONE resolution semantics; pinned by a commons-sibling tooth the same hour.
